requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-6495-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-6495-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2178-6495-6542--110.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-2279-3125-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

997-1011-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
997-1011-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-1011-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

955-1563-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

789-1580-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

252-4871-7175.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-7175.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-2079-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

147-2921-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

372-5256-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

997-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
997-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

1117-3689-6518-6967.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5240-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2232-2792-5231-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-5231-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

2034-4396-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-4396-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2173-4771-5220-6559.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1850-5226-5967.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5226-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2835-3490-4659-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2835-3490-4659-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
3967-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1742-3583-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
1742-3583-5796.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

586-4314-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1479-1692-3478.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama of the East Tree.
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama of the East Tree.
1479-1692-3478.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-1242-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

579-2645-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
579-2645-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding six mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Incubation Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1414-3462-4986.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Salvage Scout by paying {W} and sacrificing it, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvage Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

150-1457-2499-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four additional mana-producing lands.
150-1457-2499-3821.description:
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Titania.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Endless Sands and up to four other lands.
Activate your other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Endless Sands's last ability by tapping it, paying {4}, and sacrificing it, returning Peregrine Drake and Titania from exile to the battlefield.
When Titania enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
When Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, it triggers itself twice.
Resolve the first Titania trigger, returning Endless Sands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Titania trigger, returning up to one target land of your choice from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Endless Sands's second ability by tapping it and paying {2}, exiling Titania.
Repeat from step 4.

4468-4992.description:
Mystic Decree causes all creatures to lose flying and islandwalk.
Because Stormtide Leviathan prohibits creatures without flying or islandwalk from attacking, no creatures can attack.
